recipe.visualDefinition: A central soft-focus portrait of a woman wearing a white headwrap, encased within a complex, multi-layered chrome circular frame. The frame features integrated custom metallic lettering that arcs around the top and bottom, accented by bright white starburst glints against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular chrome frame acts as a portal for the central portrait.
Metallic lettering is physically integrated into the frame's concentric rings.
Bright starbursts provide high-contrast highlights against the dark void.
coreInvariants: Concentric chrome rings forming a circular border
High-gloss metallic texture with blue-tinted reflections
Four-pointed starburst glints at geometric intersections

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centered, occupying approximately 50% of the frame's interior space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular chrome frame serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular path of the chrome lettering, starting from the top arc and moving clockwise toward the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides maximum contrast for the metallic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for high-contrast isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool silver and pale blue for the metallic chrome elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and white headwrap in the central photo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright chrome highlights and the black background; low saturation in the frame, moderate in the portrait.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed as 3D chrome extrusions.
Characters follow the curvature of the circular frame.
Double-line or inline detailing within the letter bodies to simulate light reflection.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' at the bottom is oversized and acts as a bridge for the lower text arc.
The 'A' and 'F' at the top merge into the circular ring structure.

composition.position: Top and bottom arcs of the circle
Top right and left vertical margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative custom chrome lettering paired with minimalist, clean geometric sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Five-pointed star icon integrated into the frame
Horizontal speed lines on the left side

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s feel of the secondary metadata text.
The primary title requires bespoke 3D modeling to match the frame integration.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style portrait of a woman with a white headwrap, centered in a circular composition. Surround the portrait with a complex multi-ringed chrome frame featuring horizontal speed lines on the left and a star icon on the right, all set against a solid black background. Add bright four-pointed starburst flares on the chrome highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom 3D chrome lettering that follows the top and bottom arcs of the frame, ensuring the letters appear to be made of the same metallic material as the rings. Place small, clean geometric sans-serif metadata text in the upper right corner and vertically along the left edge.

verificationChecks: Does the chrome have a blue-tinted reflection?
Are the starbursts placed at the brightest points of the metal?
Is the central portrait soft-focus compared to the sharp chrome?
Does the text follow the circular path of the frame perfectly?

adjustableVariables: Color of the chrome reflections (e.g., gold instead of silver)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact brand logos or catalog numbers

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text and frame
avoid: Jagged edges on the circular frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome looks like polished metal, not flat grey.
Verify the starbursts are four-pointed and glowing.
Check that the portrait has a warm, vintage film grain.
Confirm the background is a deep, uniform black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vintage-style portrait with a custom 3D chrome circular frame that incorporates arched display typography and starburst accents against a black void.
